description: This file defines the class SugarFieldCollection, which extends SugarFieldBase. It provides methods to render detail, edit, and search views for a collection field in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, as well as to handle saving of collection data and relationships. The class manages template paths, JSON encoding of display parameters, and links relationships with related modules.

classes.name: SugarFieldCollection
classes.description: A class extending SugarFieldBase, managing collection fields in the CRM, including rendering views and saving related records.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and fetches the Smarty template for the detail view of the collection field.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and fetches the Smarty template for editing the collection field, with optional search view.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Provides the Smarty template for the search view of the collection field.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of related collection records, creating or updating records and managing relationships.
